objective: Develop a market entry strategy for high-density urban drone deliveries that bypasses restricted zones (schools, events, government buildings) while complying with altitude and weight limits, addressing consumer concerns, and leveraging the allocated $45.5M budget.
decision_question: Should OmniLogistics proceed with Project SkyNet using the Swift-Class drone fleet, and what operational adjustments are needed to avoid restricted zones and mitigate consumer concerns?

regulatory_compliance.altitude_limits: Cruising altitude 150-300 ft; below 150 ft only during VTOL
regulatory_compliance.restricted_zones: No flights over schools during hours, major sporting events, government building perimeters
regulatory_compliance.weight_limits: Total takeoff weight ≤25 lbs for unrestricted urban corridor access; Swift-Class at 18 lbs is compliant

consumer_acceptance.noise_pollution: 42% top concern; Whisper-Prop tech reduces decibels by 40%
consumer_acceptance.privacy: 35% concerned; outward cameras shuttered during final descent
consumer_acceptance.safety: 18% fear drops/malfunctions; data retention 90 days for incident investigation

financial_feasibility.cost_reduction: 35% reduction in last-mile cost ($4.10 to $2.66) by Q4 2027
financial_feasibility.breakeven: 18 months post-launch at 150,000 packages/day across top 5 markets

fleet_strategy.heavy_lifter_v2: Exceeds 25 lbs by 2.5 lbs; not suitable for urban corridors
fleet_strategy.swift_class: 18 lbs total weight; compliant; prioritize for urban centers
